stories.title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI used to argue against a California law about AI safety rules, but now the company says California should make that law stronger.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about government politics and what big tech companies want — it doesn't affect your business or daily life right now.

stories.title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
stories.simple_summary: AI companies don't have clear public plans for what to do if one of their AI systems starts behaving dangerously or goes wrong.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters for AI safety, but it's mainly a concern for engineers and regulators — most small businesses won't feel the impact yet.

stories.title: AI decodes DNA initiator sequence found in about 60% of human genes
stories.simple_summary: AI computers figured out how to read a pattern in human DNA that appears in about 60% of our genes.
stories.why_it_matters: This is important for doctors and scientists studying diseases, but it won't directly change how you run your business today.

stories.title: Trump and White House aide Natalie Harp get the LEGO treatment in ‘incredible’ AI video from parody account
stories.simple_summary: Someone used AI to make a funny fake video of Trump and a White House aide as LEGO characters.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't matter to you — it's just entertainment and parody.

stories.title: Would even an AI disaster on the scale of Hiroshima be enough to make humankind protect itself? I fear not
stories.simple_summary: A writer is worried that even if AI causes huge damage like an atomic bomb, people still might not do enough to protect themselves from it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is opinion writing about future AI risks — not something that affects your daily life right now.

stories.title: Your AI Notetaker Would Like a Word
stories.simple_summary: The headline doesn't explain enough details to know what this is about.
stories.why_it_matters: Can't tell if this matters without more information.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic makes an AI called Claude and tries to stop it from writing sexual content, but researchers found it's not that hard to get it to do so anyway.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to the company fixing the problem, but if you're using Claude for normal business tasks, it won't affect you.

stories.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, a computer chip company, is investing money in building bigger data centers (buildings full of powerful computers) for AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — Nvidia makes money when AI companies need lots of computers, so Nvidia keeps building more places for them.

stories.title: A battle over ‘Italian brainrot’ could shape who owns AI art
stories.simple_summary: There's a legal fight happening over who owns AI-made artwork and what counts as original art.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters if you're an artist or think about copyright law — most small business owners won't feel this impact yet.

stories.title: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
stories.simple_summary: LinkedIn added a button so people can mark posts that look like they were written by AI instead of by a real person, and over a million people have used it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use LinkedIn, you can now flag boring AI-generated content, which might make the site feel less cluttered.

stories.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia showed that AI works better when you give it good instructions and guardrails, even if the AI itself isn't perfect at its job.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important for companies building AI systems — it doesn't change anything for everyday business owners.

stories.title: CoreWeave vs. Nebius Group: Which Artificial Intelligence (AI) Cloud Stock Has More Upside?
stories.simple_summary: An article compares two technology stock investments to see which might make investors more money.
stories.why_it_matters: This is only for people thinking about buying stock — you don't need to do anything about this.
